name: Heirlooms stay on sale but only an account that reached level 60 on the realm can buy them
contract: Items listed in coa_item_purchase_requires_realm_level_60 stay visible in every store, but buying one needs a character on the account that reached level 60 on this realm (a level 60 or a prestiged character).

Without one the purchase is refused, nothing is charged or given, and the player is told 'You need to have reached level 60 at least once on this realm to buy this item.' in the middle of the screen and in chat.

This covers vendors (the Guardian of Time's Heirlooms list 9781001: Rethreaded Right Bear Claw 1518203 for 96000 Runes of Descension 375250), the Vanity Store (Aura of Experience 818059 for Bazaar Tokens 975001 at its VanityCollection.dbc price of 250) and the Heirloom Weapon Token store (Bloodied Arcanite Reaper 1642943 for one Heirloom Weapon Token 414010).

A level 10 character on an account whose other character is level 60 buys from the vendor. Ascension extension packets (Vanity Store, token store) are queued per account and drained by any of its online characters, so a level 60 character alone on its account is the control for those two stores.
